characteristics.$text: Once per phase, when this unit is selected as a target of an attack or selected to fight, you can use this ability. Select Defensive or Offensive and make a Leadership roll for this unit. Until the end of the phase: Defensive — models in this unit have Feel No Pain 6+ and a 5+ invulnerable save; if the roll succeeds, they instead have Feel No Pain 5+ and a 4+ invulnerable save. Offensive — this unit's melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1; if the roll succeeds, they can also re-roll wound rolls of 1. You cannot select both effects in the same phase.
